item.title: Haitian TPS holders in South Florida brace for end of their legal status
item.description: Temporary protected status was given to Haitians after the 2010 quake because Haiti was deemed too dangerous for a safe return. In June, the Supreme Court allowed the Trump administration to end TPS.

item.title: Judge allows use of police interview in Tupac Shakur murder trial
item.description: A Nevada judge ruled on Tuesday that the recording of an interview the man accused in the killing Tupac Shakur gave to police in 2008 could be used at his upcoming trial.

item.title: Rescuers search for the missing after Japan earthquake as death toll rises to 13
item.description: Soldiers and emergency workers combed through a badly damaged shopping mall and collapsed houses looking for trapped survivors Wednesday after a powerful earthquake that killed at least 13 people.

item.title: FIFA has a new plan to raise billions of dollars: Selling stakes in the World Cup
item.description: FIFA has a complex plan to sell chunks of its commercial rights to the World Cup to minority investors, including a firm run by Joshua Kushner, the brother of Jared Kushner.

item.title: As Spain battles wildfires, its politicians battle over climate change's role
item.description: Crews are still battling wildfires that broke out last week and have burned nearly 200,000 acres across Spain. The country is bracing for another round of extreme heat, with temperatures expected to top 100 degrees Fahrenheit starting Wednesday.

item.title: Artist Betye Saar, who used repurposed objects to reclaim identity, has died at 99
item.description: Saar told NPR in 2006, "I'm the kind of person who recycles materials, but I also recycle emotions and feelings." She died days away from her 100th birthday.

item.title: Keiko Fujimori is inaugurated as Peru's president following a narrow election victory
item.description: The 51-year-old daughter of the late former President Alberto Fujimori, Peru's new conservative leader has pledged to fight crime with an "iron fist."

item.title: As many are priced out of buying, the renter-owner wealth gap is wider than ever
item.description: Record high housing costs have pushed the wealth gap between renters and owners wider than ever. It's been a boon for owners even as many others are priced out.
